slides.headline: Disney Used Clicks Against a Widower
slides.subheadline: How everyday clicks became arguments against courtroom access.

items.label: Disney’s Bid
items.body: Move the death claim from court to arbitration.

items.label: Different Decision-Maker
items.body: An arbitrator instead of a judge or jury.

slides.visual_style: Monumental editorial typography with a stark consent-to-court diagram.
slides.layout_topology: Oversized headline above a central hero; two compact captions below.

svg_blueprint.concept: A streaming window connects toward a courthouse through a broken accent path, signaling an attempted move rather than an achieved outcome.
svg_blueprint.placement: Central hero occupying half the slide.

slides.headline: A Dinner. A Death. A Lawsuit.
slides.subheadline: She ate at Raglan Road in Disney Springs.

items.label: Her Death
items.body: Dr. Kanokporn Tangsuan died on October 5, 2023.

items.label: Husband’s Allegations
items.body: Staff repeatedly assured them food would suit her allergies.

slides.visual_style: Restrained memorial still life; no reconstructed portrait or scene.
slides.layout_topology: Asymmetric split: empty place setting left, human-story copy right.

slides.headline: One Click, More Than Streaming
slides.subheadline: Disney said linked terms required arbitration and barred group claims.

items.label: Signup Screen
items.body: “Agree & Continue” linked to the Subscriber Agreement.

items.label: Disputed Visibility
items.body: Piccolo’s lawyers said broader terms sat behind another link.

slides.visual_style: Interface archaeology: clean signup card contrasted with nested documents.
slides.layout_topology: Side-by-side comparison panels with matched caption positions.

svg_blueprint.concept: A simple signup surface faces a stack of linked documents. The interface is schematic, not a screenshot.
svg_blueprint.placement: Wide comparison band between headline and captions.

slides.headline: His Clicks. Her Estate’s Rights.
slides.subheadline: Disney wanted an arbitrator to decide whether arbitration applied.

items.label: Vacation Links
items.body: Disney also cited tickets, account terms and guest registration.

items.label: Contested Reach
items.body: Piccolo disputed that his clicks could bind his wife’s estate.

slides.visual_style: Technical argument map with a visibly disputed connection.
slides.layout_topology: Converging paths: transaction symbols feed one dashed bridge; captions flank it.

svg_blueprint.concept: Streaming and ticket records converge toward an estate document. The final connection remains dashed to distinguish Disney’s argument from a ruling.

slides.headline: A Click Could Change the Forum
slides.subheadline: Disney’s attempted use here remained untested, not court-approved.

items.label: Not Limitless
items.body: Coverage still required a Disney Services or agreement connection.

items.label: Not Immunity
items.body: Arbitration still allowed individual damages; it was not immunity.

slides.visual_style: Boundary cartography: a bounded field, not an all-consuming trap.
slides.layout_topology: Large central perimeter graphic with two opposing marginal captions.

svg_blueprint.concept: A consent symbol sits inside a defined perimeter. A dashed route approaches an opening, emphasizing the disputed route to a decision-maker.
svg_blueprint.placement: Centered circular hero with copy outside its boundary.

slides.headline: First Retreat. Then Dismissal.
slides.subheadline: The later dismissal was not an arbitration victory.

items.label: Disney Retreats
items.body: Disney dropped its arbitration bid in August 2024 after backlash.

items.label: Piccolo Dismisses
items.body: Piccolo permanently dismissed the lawsuit on February 27, 2026.

slides.visual_style: Documentary timeline with distinct event markers and restrained redaction-like bars.
slides.layout_topology: Two stacked event bands beside a vertical chronological spine.

svg_blueprint.concept: Two separated document cards distinguish the withdrawn arbitration request from the later permanent dismissal. No simulated court stamps or signatures.
svg_blueprint.placement: Vertical spine alongside the two event captions.

slides.headline: Save the Click. Question Its Reach.
slides.subheadline: Scrutinize the route to accountability, not just possible damages.

items.label: Save Receipts
items.body: Keep signup screens, linked agreements and ticket terms.

items.label: Check Reach
items.body: Ask counsel who is bound, which disputes count and who decides.

slides.visual_style: Practical evidence kit: archived records paired with a focused inspection lens.
slides.layout_topology: Two large action tiles above a compact closing headline.

svg_blueprint.concept: A document folder and magnifying glass turn the closing slide into a preservation-and-review playbook without inventing an opt-out right.
svg_blueprint.placement: Paired icons occupying the upper half; action copy directly underneath.
